Annual Meetings

Afternoon Session - 1999 Meeting

Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger continue to explain why they're not buying hot internet stocks, dismiss efficient market theory as "silly," and offer advice on starting out as an investor.

Fri, Nov 2 2018 • 4:17 PM EDT
Key Chapters —
  1. 3. Stocks can't keep growing at the same rate
  2. 8. Avoiding tech: we're "willing to trade away a big payoff for a certain payoff"
  3. 9. Don't "dance in and out of the companies you really love"
  4. 11. Markets are "fairly" efficient, but efficient market theory is "silly"
  5. 15. Investing advice: start early and think for yourself
  6. 16. How Buffett learned the insurance business
  7. 27. Expect "huge impact" from internet, but too hard to pick winners
  8. 28. "We will never turn our money over to somebody else"
  9. 31. "Journalistic process" good for learning about companies
  10. 32. Creating value for subsidiaries by leaving them alone
  11. 35. "We don't sugarcoat things"
